mapper.select: SELECT a.gene, a.clinical_significance_desc FROM mod_hrr AS a JOIN panel_gene AS b ON a.gene = b.gene WHERE b.product_name = #{panel} AND a.deleted = 0

SELECT b.gene_symbol as gene, b.variant, b.ori_variant, b.mutFreq as mut_freq FROM data_file_status AS a JOIN snp_indel_file AS b ON a.file_id = b.file_id WHERE a.subbarcode = #{subbarcode} AND a.product_name = #{product_name} AND a.analysis_date = #{analysis_date} AND a.file_type in ('SNP', 'INDEL') AND a.status = 'Loaded' AND (b.report IS NULL OR b.report = '1')
SELECT a.gene, a.protein, a.prognosis_evaluation, a.prognosis_assessment FROM mod_thyroid AS a WHERE a.deleted = 0
SELECT a.gene, a.protein, a.prognosis_evaluation, a.prognosis_assessment FROM mod_melanoma AS a JOIN panel_gene AS b ON a.gene = b.gene WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND b.product_name = #{panel}
